test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Diya is sitting second to the left of Arjun. Pawan is sitting second to the right of Bhim. Kapil is sitting second to the left of Diya. Diya is an immediate neighbour of both Pawan and Ram. Who is the immediate neighbour of both Pawan and Bhim?
solution: **Given:** Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) Diya is sitting second to the left of Arjun. 2) Kapil is sitting second to the left of Diya.
